counting_convention.mac: one fused multiply-add counts as one MAC
counting_convention.scalar_add: one scalar addition, including a bias addition
counting_convention.constant_load: one consumed scalar fixed or learned constant
counting_convention.embedding_value_copy: one scalar copied from the looked-up input vector
counting_convention.state_copy: one scalar copied between state buffers
counting_convention.comparison: one scalar comparison or branch predicate
counting_convention.elementwise_mul: one scalar multiplication outside a MAC
counting_convention.quantization_clip: one scalar clip comparison at one bound
counting_convention.quantization_scale_mul: one scalar multiply by the frozen q8 scale or reciprocal
counting_convention.parameter_loads_inside_mac: not counted separately; included in the MAC

matched_gru_d8.equations: z=sigmoid(W_z x+U_z h+b_z); r=sigmoid(W_r x+U_r h+b_r); n=tanh(W_n x+U_n(r*h)+b_n); h_next=z*h+(1-z)*n

parameter_count.bias_convention: one bias vector per GRU gate; no duplicate framework bias
